client_needs_summary: Their dispatch team is still tracking driver assignments in a shared spreadsheet, which breaks whenever two people edit it at once. They want a single system that shows live driver status and assigns jobs automatically based on proximity.
project_scope: Build a dispatch dashboard that pulls driver GPS pings from their existing fleet-tracking API, shows live positions on a map, and lets a dispatcher assign or auto-assign a job to the nearest available driver.
goals_and_objectives: Cut average dispatch time from 12 minutes to under 4 minutes, and eliminate the double-booking errors that currently happen 3-4 times a week.
recommended_services: A dispatch web app with live map view, an auto-assignment engine, and a driver mobile view for accepting jobs.
proposed_timeline: 8 weeks: 2 weeks discovery and design, 4 weeks build, 2 weeks pilot with one depot before full rollout.
estimated_pricing: $42,000 fixed fee, payable in three milestones of $14,000 each.
